title: Still Sticks, but not as much as the SS
text:
Still Sticks, but not as much as the SS. I like having 2 pots. I recommend that to everybody. I was surprised I would use both pots on the same day, making for a more versatile , flexible machine.

Don’t assume that this one is non stick like a good skillet or stove top pot, it isn’t. Food still sticks and is difficult to remove . However, it is better than the SS.
